description: DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities per RFC 6698. Publish the TLS certificate hash in a TLSA DNS record alongside the SRV discovery record. DNS becomes the CA — if you control your DNS zone, you control your identity. Requires DNSSEC for cryptographic guarantees. Pairs perfectly with DNS-based discovery (KITH-beps): the TLSA record sits next to the SRV record. Can layer on top of TOFU or ACME as additional hardening.
title: Auth mechanism: DANE (DNS-based cert auth)
